voice.welcome: Ari is making a garden guest book. Come grow a picture graph!
voice.menu-sort: Sort and stamp the garden visitors.
voice.menu-compare: Find which garden group has more, fewer, or the same.
voice.sort-prompt: Put each garden visitor with the matching picture.
voice.sort-nudge: Look at the visitor, then find the same picture.
voice.sort-success: Every garden visitor is in the graph!
voice.count-bee: Tap each bee and count with me.
voice.count-butterfly: Tap each butterfly and count with me.
voice.count-ladybug: Tap each ladybug and count with me.
voice.count-nudge: Tap a picture that has not grown a leaf yet.
voice.count-success: You counted every picture in the column!
voice.compare-same: Tap the two columns with the same number.
voice.compare-nudge: Look at how high each picture column grows.
voice.compare-same-nudge: Find two columns that reach the same row.
voice.compare-most-success: Yes! That column has the most.
voice.compare-fewest-success: Yes! That column has the fewest.
voice.compare-same-success: Yes! Those two have the same number.
voice.finale: Ari’s Great Garden Guest Book is full of pictures, numbers, and blooms. Beautiful graphing!
